definition_quote.value: "Practice of optometry" means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures: (i) The examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions... (ii) The employment of objective or subjective physical means to determine the accommodative or refractive conditions... (iii) The adaptation or the adjustment of the lenses or prisms or the use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents... (iv) The examination of the human eye for contact lenses and the fitting or insertion of contact lenses... (v) The employment of objective or subjective means, including diagnostic pharmaceutical agents...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures

value: examination of the human eye for defects or abnormal conditions
objective or subjective physical means to determine accommodative or refractive conditions

drug_authority.value: Topical diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (with board certification); topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (with board certification); topically or orally administered antiglaucoma drugs; orally administered prescription drugs for anterior segment conditions (with 50% of CE hours in pharmacological management of ocular conditions); controlled substances in schedules 3, 4, and 5; dihydrocodeinone combination drugs. Excludes schedule 2 controlled substances, oral cortical steroids.
drug_authority.quote: "Therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" means 1 or more of the following: (i) A topically administered prescription drug or other topically administered drug...for the purpose of...correcting, remedying, or relieving a defect or abnormal condition of the anterior segment... (ii) A topically or orally administered antiglaucoma drug. (iii) An orally administered prescription drug...administered by an optometrist who has completed 50% of the continuing education hours required for renewal of a license in the category of pharmacological management of ocular conditions.

surgery_prohibited.quote: "Practice of optometry" means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures

surgery_definition.value: Invasive procedures means: use of lasers other than for observation; use of ionizing radiation; use of therapeutic ultrasound; administration of medication by injection; procedures that include an incision.
surgery_definition.quote: "Invasive procedures" means all of the following: (i) The use of lasers other than for observation. (ii) The use of ionizing radiation. (iii) The use of therapeutic ultrasound. (iv) The administration of medication by injection. (v) Procedures that include an incision.
